Eternal Unveils Privacy-Focused AI Assistant Dark.ai

Indian company Eternal has unveiled Dark.ai, an artificial intelligence assistant designed with a focus on privacy. Deepinder Goyal, founder of Eternal, stated that the AI assistant is being developed with a core principle of privacy-by-design. Goyal also revealed that he built the assistant because he felt 'resented for ghosting' by AI models, implying a desire for more direct and private interaction. Eternal plans a global launch for Dark.ai within the current year.
